svg.title: JKY Terminal — what it does, in four scenes
svg.desc: An animated JKY Terminal window. Scene one: docker ps output becomes a panel beneath the raw text, and a panel action types a command without running it. Scene two: the window closes while a build runs, a supervisor keeps the shell alive, and reopening shows the output that was missed. Scene three: the assistant searches the code freely but must ask before running a command. Scene four: the jky theme command changes the whole window's theme.
